test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

Was the beggar not being beaten by her?

options.text: Was not she beating the beggar?
Was the beggar beaten by her?
Was she not beating the beggar?

solution:
The correct answer is **"Was she not beating the beggar?"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in Passive Voice. It is in Simple Past Tense(Interrogative, Negative sentence ).
 
• As per the given question, we must change it to Active Voice. 
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
 
 
• Did + Subject + not+ V1 + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Was/were + Subject (objective case) + not + V3 + by + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• *Did they not solve the question? (Active Voice)*
 
• *Was the question not solved by them? (Passive Voice)*
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'they'.​​
 
• The object of the given sentence is 'the conference'. 
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject.
 
• The preposition 'by' will be removed. 
 
• In active voice, the subject performs the action, so we need to rephrase the sentence to make the subject the doer of the action.
 
• **"She"** is the subject and "beating" is the action, so we need to make** "she"** the subject of the sentence.
 
• The negative **"not"** should also be moved after the subject to make the sentence clearer.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.
